$comment: P69 (lane `cs`, D-C-A-STORAGE-CLASS-SPECIFIER-IN-A-COMPOUND-LITERAL-IS-A-PARSE-ERROR): C23 6.5.3.6's `( storage-class-specifiers type-name ) braced-initializer`, judged as the definition `SC typeof(T) ID = { IL };` in its own scope — `static` / `static thread_local` literals are one object for the program, `constexpr` ones are compound literal CONSTANTS (C23 6.6p6: an array bound and a case label here), `register` ones are automatic. DSS refused every one at the parser (P_NoAlternativeMatched). MEASURED 2026-09-30 through `dssharness run probe-reference-cc`, this file: gcc 13.3.0 -std=c2x (run 20260930-220605-dd4cc23e) and mingw-w64 gcc 13.2.0 -std=c2x (20260930-220731-5fcd1763) build it and exit 11 — the `accumulate` check, and ONLY it: gcc reads the INITIALIZER of `(static int){ 0 }` as the `+=` operand (its -S output stores n, run 20260930-213022-a9194663) while it persists the same object under `++` and through `&` (both checks pass on gcc); C23 6.5.3.6p7 initializes the object once, before start-up, so DSS reads the object and exits 42 (the fork is recorded in the row). clang 18.1.3 and MSVC 19.51 parse no storage-class compound literal (C2736). The release arm is REPORT-ONLY: its value is that the optimizer keeps each static literal one persistent object.
